body: The old well's depths seem darker now as shadows stretch across its walls like gnarled fingers, each one reaching for me. My heart pounds against my chest, echoing loudly inside my head. I take a deep breath, steeling myself for whatever might come. But even before anything else can be done, I realize there’s something else too—my fear of losing control over this situation is growing stronger.
